market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Fed hike + 5% 10-year yield creates headwind for equities. Expect volatility as markets digest Warsh's hawkish path. Oil/diesel volatility adds noise. Crypto weak on Clarity Act failure. 1-3 months: range-bound with downside risk if Fed signals second hike.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle is structural (ASML 110+ EUV by 2028, Nvidia space computing 2027). Pharma innovation (BioNTech, Lilly) drives secular growth. Housing supply constraints limit downside. Key risk: if AI inflation triggers prolonged tightening, recession risk rises by H2 2027.
